job_title: Forecast weekly sales for a bakery chain
text: I built a Prophet based forecasting API for a grocery chain that cut stock-outs by 18 percent. I can do the same for your bakery.
I shipped a LangChain and Pinecone RAG chatbot that deflected 35 percent of support tickets. Happy to share the architecture.
I modelled churn with XGBoost on dbt features in Snowflake and improved campaign precision by 22 percent.
Experienced with PyTorch and OpenCV defect detection exported to ONNX, 96 percent recall.
I know Celery and Redis well and built an ingestion system for two million transactions a day.
Hello, I am a hard working expert with many years of experience and I can do anything you need quickly.
